summary: Admin can change a price by any amount
description: The admin guide says a single edit cannot move a price by more than 50%. No such check exists. An admin fat-fingered $89.00 to $8.90 and we sold 40 units before anyone noticed.
acceptance_criteria: An edit that changes the price by more than 50% is rejected.
The message tells the admin the allowed range.
The limit applies in both directions.
